summary.text: Bear mosquitoes are mosquitoes as huge as bears, with terrifying mouths and numbers far greater than the dark venomous snakes, each with desolate beast battle strength.

claims.text: While the three rank eight Gu Immortals avoid fights as they retreat through black heaven, they meet bear mosquitoes besides a second, larger group of dark venomous snakes. The mosquitoes are huge like bears and have terrifying mouths, but most importantly their numbers are huge, far greater than the dark venomous snakes. Each bear mosquito has desolate beast battle strength.

The bear mosquito group is very large, and on one occasion it surrounds the three Immortal Gu Houses, which have to fight. Tens of thousands of bear mosquitoes attack at once. After that battle, the Gu Immortals who wanted to fight all fall silent, realizing how dangerous black heaven is. Only the three Immortal Gu Houses and the protection of the rank eight Gu Immortals keep them from all dying under the attacks of the bear mosquitoes.

On a later stretch of the journey, within two hours the Central Continent Gu Immortals meet several ghost spirit fox groups and bear mosquito groups, and either retreat or fight, using the might of the Immortal Gu Houses to move forward.
